newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - EPIC Design raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - EPIC Design raised to buy.

text.p: -- SoundView Financial analyst Erach Desai said in a research note that he raised his short-term recommendation on EPIC Design Technology Inc to buy from hold.
-- The analyst also raised the fiscal year 1996 earnings estimate to $0.65 per share from $0.64, the fiscal 1997 estimate to $0.85 from $0.84 and the fiscal 1998 to $1.10 from $1.05.
-- The long-term buy recommendation is unchanged.
-- Shares rose one to 25 in late morning Nasdaq trade.
"The company landed a major contract, which will result in the company reporting a positive quarter. We had the short-term hold because we were concerned" about the period," he said.
-- Desai said the contract has not been publicly announced by the company, and would only describe it as a "multimillion dollar" order.

-- The analyst also raised the stock "given EPIC is selling compelling technology for next generation of (semiconductor) design and has emerged from the September quarter, which was the toughest quarter for semiconductor downturn.
